title: The Sun and Her Flowers
author: Rupi Kaur
summary: A collection of short, simple poems and drawings in five sections: wilting, falling, rooting, rising and blooming. They deal with loss, trauma, immigration, femininity and healing.
readIf: you want short, accessible poems about heartbreak and self-worth that you can read in one sitting.
skipIf: you prefer intricate, formally complex poetry or are sensitive to themes of sexual violence.
